entities.summary: Saint Petersburg State University of Architecture and Civil Engineering (SPSUACE) (Russian: Санкт-Петербургский государственный архитектурно-строительный университет (СПбГАСУ), romanized: Sankt-Peterburgskiy gosudarstvennyy arkhitekturno-stroitel'nyy universitet (SPbGASU)) is a Russian federal state-owned higher education institution based in Saint Petersburg.
